entries.460cde43bb5a083e: This is a single-segment business that produces and sells eggs. It consists of production operations (raising and producing laying hens at 5 company-owned farms for mature hens in Hokkaido and 3 farms in Tohoku), manufacturing operations (sorting and packaging at 5 GP plants in Hokkaido and 3 GP plants in Tohoku certified under FSSC22000, and production of liquid egg and hot-spring egg at the Wattsu liquid egg plant), and sales operations (direct sales in Hokkaido without wholesalers, expansion of direct sales in Tohoku through branches, and exports to the Hong Kong market). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,107 million.
